items.heading: Machbous Qatari
details: Key ingredients: rice, lamb or chicken, dried lime, baharat
Brown lamb or chicken with onion and baharat spices.
Add dried lime and tomato, simmering until tender.
Cook rice in the flavorful broth.
Serve the rice topped with the meat and fried onions or nuts.

items.heading: Balaleet
details: Key ingredients: vermicelli noodles, sugar, cardamom, egg
Cook thin vermicelli noodles until tender.
Toss with sugar, cardamom and a little rosewater.
Make a thin savory omelet separately.
Serve the sweet noodles topped with the savory omelet.
